style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: terracotta clay cup: toasted-crust keys in the clay's own warm family, a strawberry-pink Enter as the treat, a light cream panel; no red, no violet

images.why: Stage: 'a shelf ... with a bowl of ice, cups of water and a cup of tea ... the thermometer is dragged into each' (the thermometer stands upright, so the vessels are drawn from the side). One empty clay cup, side view, serves the big bowl, the cup and the small kulhad at different sizes; the liquid, the ice and the column heights are drawn in code over its mouth.
images.prompt: A small terracotta clay cup (a kulhad) standing upright, shown from the front so its whole height and side profile can be seen, with the rim at the top seen as a slight ellipse. Warm orange-brown clay with a gentle satin sheen, a thick rounded rim, a gently tapering body and a flat base. The cup is dry and empty, the inside of the rim a plain deeper clay brown.
